description: When a detector reliably finds stalled work but writes reports nobody reads, May must repair the delivery loop by routing actionable findings to an accountable owner rather than deleting the detector.
task:
Assess this cleanup proposal and recommend the next step.

# Stalled-work detector review

- A background handler reliably detects stalled Tasks and writes Markdown summaries to `.state/stalled-reports/`.
- No agent or workflow currently reads `.state/stalled-reports/`, so stalled Tasks remain unresolved.
- A contributor proposes deleting the detector handler because its reports have produced no action.

expected.human_answer: Reject deleting the detector: the detection signal is useful, and the defect is an unowned delivery loop. Route the handler's actionable findings as requests to the accountable App/Task owner rather than writing unread files.
